title: Mutual Equilibrium: Multimodal Representation Learning through Reciprocal Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2609.39456v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This work proposes a mutual feedback architecture, MEQ, that refines the two inputs, of possibly different modalities, into a pair of coupled embeddings such that each embedding reflects the information of the other. The core idea is to incorporate continuous interchange of information between the two inputs. This idea leads to a mutual feedback architecture consisting of two components whose outputs are fed back into the other. The final output of this model is defined as the fixed point of this interaction. We provide theoretical analysis that offers interpretation of this model as well as design choices to prevent failure cases. We show the benefits of MEQ through classification and visual grounding tasks spanning various datasets. Quantitatively, our model outperforms or shows competitive performance on concatenation-based multimodal classification problems. translated_title: 相互均衡：通过互惠反馈实现的多模态表示学习
translated_abstract: 这项工作提出了一种相互反馈架构MEQ，它将两个可能具有不同模态的输入精炼为一对耦合的嵌入表示，使得每个嵌入都能反映另一个嵌入所包含的信息。其核心思想是在两个输入之间进行持续的信息交换。这一思想催生了一种相互反馈架构，该架构由两个组件构成，且每个组件的输出都会反馈给对方。该模型的最终输出被定义为这种交互作用的不动点。我们提供了理论分析，对该模型给出了解释，并提出了避免失败情况的设计选择。我们通过跨越多个数据集的分类和视觉定位任务展示了MEQ的优势。在定量方面，我们的模型在基于拼接的多模态分类问题上表现优于现有方法或具有相当的竞争力。在定性方面，所提出的交互机制使模型能够渐进地……
tldr: 提出MEQ相互反馈架构，通过两个组件互相反馈迭代直至达到不动点，将不同模态的输入精炼为相互耦合、彼此映照的嵌入表示，并在多模态分类与视觉定位任务上取得了优异或具有竞争力的表现。
en_tdlr: Proposes MEQ, a mutual feedback architecture that iteratively refines two inputs (possibly of different modalities) into coupled embeddings through reciprocal feedback until reaching a fixed point, achieving superior or competitive performance on multimodal classification and visual grounding tasks.
